correctness.rationale: The open-neighborhood signatures prove at most one empty matched column; total domination reduces to exact layer occupancy conditions; their sufficient and necessary three-pattern classification covers n>=3, with two additional n=2 sets. Inclusion-exclusion counts all cardinalities, correctly restores the n=3 double-subtraction, and yields the minimum coefficients. Full independent graph-level all-subset enumeration through n=10 matches every coefficient and a separate checker matches all minimum structures. Infinite claim derives from exact proof, not data extrapolation.

value.rationale: The theorem enumerates every locating-total dominating subset of an infinite canonical graph family, not just an easily known bound or isolated small-graph coefficient. It explains the sharp n=5 drop from n to n-1 and provides an exact exponential family of optimum sets with structural classification. The line-graph connection supplies a natural second interpretation.
